newsitem.title: FINLAND: SISU SIGNS $150 MLN SYNDICATED 5-YEAR LOAN.
newsitem.headline: SISU SIGNS $150 MLN SYNDICATED 5-YEAR LOAN.

text.p: Finnish state-owned heavy vehicles maker Oy Sisu Ab said on Friday it had signed an agreement on a five-year $150 million syndicated loan the lead managers of which are Merita and Citibank .
"The amount of the loan was raised to $150 million," Sisu said in a statement.
Sisu said the bullet loan was unsecured and that it would be used to replace its other financing limits and to refinance existing loans at better terms.
Sisu said the other syndicate members are:

Postipankki, Den Danske Bank, Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken, Suomen Vientiluotto, Landesbank Schleswig-Holstein, Nordbanken, Societe Generale, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, Sakura Bank, Vereins- und Westbank, Banque Indosuez, Credit Lyonnais, Handelsbanken, Midland Bank, Sumitomo Bank and Unibank.
